title: Benchmark appointed data provider for Veramark platform
gist: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence is the primary data provider for Veramark's (formerly the Copper Mark) Responsible Metals Value Chain Platform, launched 28 October with 20+ Value Chain Partners, supplying five years of copper supply and end-use demand data, including data-centre demand, refreshed every six months.

insights.claim: Veramark, formerly the Copper Mark, launched its Responsible Metals Value Chain Platform on 28 October, uniting miners, smelters, refiners, fabricators, recyclers, traders, manufacturers and financial institutions on traceability, transparency, emissions and recycled content.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Industry-wide traceability infrastructure for copper is being built out.
insights.locator: Veramark, formerly the Copper Mark, launched

insights.claim: More than 20 companies have signed up as Value Chain Partners on Veramark's platform, adding to Veramark's assurance coverage of over 140 upstream sites.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Early adoption scale for responsible-copper assurance.
insights.locator: Veramark, formerly the Copper Mark, launched

insights.claim: Benchmark's Michael Finch says the aim is a common independent baseline on copper supply and demand so traceability, emissions and recycled-content discussions use the same numbers.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Shared data baselines could standardise ESG claims in copper.

insights.claim: Benchmark's dataset for the platform covers five years of global and regional mine and refinery supply, refined and total demand, and end-use demand split from electrical infrastructure into grid, generation, storage and data centres, refreshed every six months.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Data centres are now tracked as a distinct copper end-use segment.
insights.locator: Responsible sourcing decisions rely on a clear picture

insights.claim: Benchmark states electrification, grid investment and data centres are reshaping copper demand.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.quote: at a time when electrification, grid investment and data centres are reshaping demand
insights.locator: The partnership extends Benchmark's copper coverage
